enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.title: First task: propose with a plan document
enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.description: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
enableFirstTaskPlanProposal.toggle: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting

enableBetaSkills.title: Beta skills
enableBetaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.

enableBuiltInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
enableBuiltInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

enableCases.title: Cases
enableCases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
enableCases.footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

enableConferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
enableConferenceRoomChat.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
enableConferenceRoomChat.ariaLabel: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

enableDecisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.

enableEnvironments.title: Enable Environments
enableEnvironments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

enableExternalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
enableExternalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

enableIsolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
enableIsolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

enableExperimentalFileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
enableExperimentalFileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

enableNativeRunner.title: Paperclip Runner
enableNativeRunner.description: Allow new Codex agents to select the experimental Rust Paperclip Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. Onboarding continues to use legacy adapters. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.

enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.title: Simplified English Interactions
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.ariaLabel: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting

enableStatusCards.title: Status Cards
enableStatusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
enableStatusCards.footnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.

enableStreamlinedUi.title: Streamlined UI
enableStreamlinedUi.description: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
enableStreamlinedUi.footnote: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.

enableSummaries.title: Summaries
enableSummaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
enableSummaries.footnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.

enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.title: Paperclip Developer Mode
enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.description: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
enablePaperclipDeveloperMode.ariaLabel: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting

enableManagedSandboxOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
enableManagedSandboxOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
enableManagedSandboxOnly.ariaLabel: Toggle managed environment only experimental setting

autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

enableServerInfoDebugView.title: Server Info Debug View
enableServerInfoDebugView.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
enableServerInfoDebugView.ariaLabel: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting

enableSmokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
enableSmokeLab.description: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.

enableIssuePlanDecompositions.title: Task Plan Decomposition
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.ariaLabel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

enableClassicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
enableClassicTaskInterface.description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
enableClassicTaskInterface.footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
enableClassicTaskInterface.ariaLabel: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting

enableGoalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
enableGoalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
enableGoalsSidebarLink.ariaLabel: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting

enableChatConnectors.title: Chat connectors
enableChatConnectors.description: Connect agents to Slack, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
enableChatConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides chat setup, channels, and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. GitHub and other tool connectors stay available.

localizationIssueChrome.denialVisibilityTitle: Task is outside this actor's visibility
localizationIssueChrome.denialVisibilityDescription: Issue writes are open by default, but only for tasks the actor can already read. {{issue}} is not visible to {{actor}}, so its comment, update, child, and assignment channels are all closed — the wall is visibility, not the write itself.
localizationIssueChrome.denialVisibilityWho: {{assignee}}, and any agent or board member the task is visible to.
localizationIssueChrome.denialVisibilityPath: Ask the board to widen visibility for {{actor}}, or create a child issue with the request in its description (issue creation is a separate, open write path) and let its assignee act.
localizationIssueChrome.denialClassTitle: This actor class cannot write to tasks
localizationIssueChrome.denialClassDescription: Default-open issue writes are a standard-trust privilege. Low-trust, skill-test, and task-bridge scopes keep their existing tight walls, so {{actor}} cannot write to {{issue}} no matter who it acts for.
localizationIssueChrome.denialClassWho: A standard-trust agent in this company, or a board member.
localizationIssueChrome.denialClassPath: Report the request upward and let a standard-trust agent make the write — actor-class scope cannot be widened per task.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCeilingDescription: This action was denied because {{responsible}} — the user this run acts on behalf of — does not have permission to perform it. The agent may be allowed, but a run can never exceed the permissions of the user it acts for, so the action is blocked. The write to {{issue}} was refused for that reason.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCeilingWho: {{responsible}} once authorized, or anyone already permitted to write to {{issue}}.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCeilingPath: Grant {{responsible}} the required permission, or have someone who is authorized take this action instead.
localizationIssueChrome.denialUnavailableDescription: This run acts on behalf of {{responsible}}, but that account was removed or deactivated, so its permissions can no longer be evaluated. The agent's own permissions are not enough on their own — every action still requires an active responsible user. The write to {{issue}} was refused for that reason.
localizationIssueChrome.denialUnavailableWho: A board member, or {{actor}} once it has an active responsible user.
localizationIssueChrome.denialUnavailablePath: Mark the work blocked and reassign a responsible user (or reactivate the account) before the agent continues.
localizationIssueChrome.denialLockTitle: Another agent's run owns this task
localizationIssueChrome.denialLockDescription: {{assignee}} has {{issue}} checked out and a run is live. Checkout and run ownership stay assignee-scoped even though writes are open, so field edits belong to the run that holds the lock until it finishes.
localizationIssueChrome.denialLockWho: {{assignee}}'s live run, or an agent holding the manage-active-checkouts permission.
localizationIssueChrome.denialLockPath: Comment instead of patching — comments stay open and wake {{assignee}} — or wait for the run to release the lock and retry.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCapTitle: This run has spent its cross-issue write budget
localizationIssueChrome.denialCapDescription: A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCapAttemptDescription: A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined; this was attempt {{attempt}}. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCapWho: {{actor}} on its next heartbeat run, or {{assignee}} on {{issue}} directly.
localizationIssueChrome.denialCapPath: Consolidate what is left into one comment on your own task, or end the run and continue on the next heartbeat — the budget resets per run.
localizationIssueChrome.denialContextTitle: Cross-issue writes need a run to attribute them to
localizationIssueChrome.denialContextDescription: Every agent comment and task update is attributed to a heartbeat run so the cross-issue cap can be counted and the audit trail can name who acted for whom. This request arrived without a valid run, so it could not be contained.
localizationIssueChrome.denialContextWho: {{actor}}, once the request carries its own run id.
localizationIssueChrome.denialContextPath: Send the `X-Paperclip-Run-Id` header with your current run (`$PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID`) and retry.
localizationIssueChrome.denialSpoofTitle: Responsible user cannot be chosen by the caller
localizationIssueChrome.denialSpoofDescription: `onBehalfOfUserId` is derived from the authenticated actor, never from the request body — an agent cannot pick the human whose authority it rides. The attempt was recorded in the audit log.
localizationIssueChrome.denialSpoofWho: {{actor}} itself: the write is allowed, only the chosen attribution is not.
localizationIssueChrome.denialSpoofPath: Remove `onBehalfOfUserId` from the request and retry; the server fills in {{responsible}} from your run.

localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.doc_maintenance: Keep project docs aligned with recent code and feature changes — detect drift, update affected pages, and add release-relevant notes without rewriting unchanged sections.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.issue_triage: Triage Paperclip inbox issues that are stale, blocked, in-review, or assigned-but-not-progressing, and decide a single next action per issue (resume, reassign, unblock, escalate, or close).
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.reflection_coach: Reflect on another agent's recent execution record and propose the smallest durable instruction, skill, or tool-description change. Use for evidence-backed coaching proposals, never hot-swaps.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.status_card_query: Create and maintain agent-authored Paperclip status cards, or compile a prose interest prompt into bounded CompanySearchQuery objects and write the first summary from the assigned Summarizer run.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.summarize_status: Write a short, colloquial summary for a Paperclip summary slot: open with the 1–3 specific, concrete actions the reader needs to take right now to unblock the work, then a brief plain-language status, streaming progress as it works.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.task_planning: Turn a Paperclip issue or request into a structured implementation plan with child task graph, blockers, owners, and acceptance criteria, then save it as the issue `plan` document.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.paperclip_capsules: Generate, implement, or review Paperclip capsule visuals. Use for capsule art, agent capsules, heartbeat status capsules, identicons, capsule banks, or brand-usage validation.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.wireframe: Produce low-fidelity black-and-white UI wireframes as SVGs or viewer pages. Use when asked to wireframe, sketch a screen, draft a layout, make a low-fi mockup, or publish wireframes.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.qa_acceptance: Produce QA acceptance criteria and a manual validation plan for a feature change — golden path, edge cases, error states, performance limits, and explicit pass/fail evidence.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.github_pr_workflow: Prepare a GitHub pull request from a feature branch — branch hygiene, commit shape, title/body, verification notes, screenshots for UI work, and replies to review comments.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.agent_browser: Drive a real browser to inspect or interact with a web page or app — navigate, take screenshots, read console and network, fill simple forms — for verification tasks, not unattended automation.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.release_announcement: Write a release announcement — changelog, blog post, in-app note, or social post — that leads with user impact, names the audience, and includes upgrade/migration steps without filler.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.simplified_english: Write user-facing comments, plans, and documents in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — short, unambiguous sentences with approved words and one meaning each — so readers understand them the first time.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.ramp: Fetch and follow Ramp's published agent playbooks inside Paperclip, with mandatory approval gates for spend, incorporation, cards, account setup, and other financial actions.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.design_critique: Give a structured product design critique — user job clarity, hierarchy, affordance, error states, accessibility, and consistency — focused on what to change, in what order, and why.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.last30days: Research what people actually say about any topic in the last 30 days. Pulls posts and engagement from Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, and the web.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.prepare_mcp_integration: Prepare MCP/vendor integrations through cited research, a content PR, exact-revision human approval, and one governed Paperclip connector PR per approved connection. Use for new integration research and delivery; not for ad hoc connector coding that bypasses the playbooks.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.paperclip: Interact with the Paperclip control plane API for task coordination and governance. Use when checking assignments, updating issue status, posting comments, delegating work, managing routines, or calling Paperclip API endpoints.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.paperclip_board: Manage a Paperclip company as a board member via chat. Use when the user wants onboarding, company or agent management, approvals, task monitoring, cost oversight, or work product review in the Paperclip control plane.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.paperclip_converting_plans_to_tasks: Convert Paperclip plans into executable issue graphs. Use when asked to plan, scope, or break down Paperclip company work into assigned tasks with specialty fit, dependencies, blockers, and parallelization.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.paperclip_create_agent: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.
localizationBundledSkillDescriptions.para_memory_files: Use a file-based PARA memory system to store, retrieve, and organize durable knowledge across sessions. Trigger on saving facts, daily notes, entity records, weekly synthesis, recall, tacit user patterns, or plan memory.

guidance.slashUnconfirmedRetry: Slack may have accepted the task-start message, so Paperclip will not replay it automatically. Check Slack first; an explicit retry can create a duplicate starter message and task.
guidance.slashUnconfirmedLegacy: Slack may have accepted the task-start message. This older action lacks the context required for a safe explicit retry, so check Slack and cancel it here before submitting a new command.
guidance.slashConfirmed: Slack accepted the task-start message. Paperclip is completing durable task admission without sending another Slack message.
guidance.slashAdmitting: Slack accepted the task-start message. A Paperclip worker is admitting the task without replaying the Slack send.
guidance.slashRejected: Slack rejected the task-start message. Submit the command again to retry.
guidance.slashCancelled: An operator cancelled this unconfirmed task start.
guidance.replyUnconfirmedClose: The provider may have accepted this reply, but Paperclip could not confirm it or close the task conversation. Check the provider first. Marking it delivered closes the conversation; retrying can create a duplicate message.
guidance.replyUnconfirmed: The provider may have accepted this reply, but Paperclip could not confirm it. Check the provider first. Retrying can create a duplicate message.
guidance.sessionUnavailable: Slack has not enabled native session status for this destination. Message delivery continues.
guidance.sessionRejected: Slack rejected the session indicator update. Check app permissions and channel access; message delivery is tracked separately.
guidance.sessionWaiting: The Slack session indicator is waiting to sync. Paperclip will not resend the response.
guidance.sessionWorking: Working status is refreshed automatically while the run remains active.
guidance.stopProcessed: Paperclip stopped the work authorized by this request.
guidance.stopCancelled: No work was stopped: this request was no longer authorized or its target was no longer current.
guidance.stopRetry: The Stop request could not finish yet. Paperclip will retry against the original work only.
guidance.stopFailed: The Stop request could not be completed. Check the task's current run before trying again.
guidance.stopProcessing: Paperclip is processing this Stop request against its original task and run.
guidance.githubIngress: An authenticated GitHub webhook could not be processed. Fix the connection or destination, then redeliver it from the GitHub App's Recent Deliveries page.
guidance.recoverySourceChanged: The original comment changed or is no longer available. Paperclip did not replay its old contents.
guidance.recoveryIneligible: This callback was not an eligible current user comment. Paperclip did not replay it.
guidance.recoveryReceived: Paperclip received this callback. Its normal access checks and processing still apply.
guidance.recoveryRequested: Paperclip asked GitHub to resend a recent missed message. This does not yet confirm receipt or a reply. Automatic requests are limited; if it remains unanswered, check the App's Recent Deliveries and send your request again in the current conversation.
guidance.recoveryHistoryLimit: Recent webhook volume exceeded automatic recovery's bounded scan. No partial history was replayed. Check the App's Recent Deliveries for missed messages.
guidance.recoveryCallbackMismatch: The GitHub App's callback no longer matches this connection. Reconnect the App to repair it; repository access will not change.
guidance.recoveryScanFailed: Paperclip could not check GitHub's failed deliveries. The check will retry with backoff; normal callbacks are still processed.
guidance.githubIngressDelivery: GitHub delivery {{deliveryId}} was authenticated, but Paperclip could not finish processing it. Fix the connection or destination, then redeliver this delivery from the GitHub App's Recent Deliveries page.

sep12Connections.removingAgentNotice: Removing an assigned agent stops receiving and sending from its inbox.
sep12Connections.unrestrictedInbox: Anyone can email an unrestricted inbox
sep12Connections.allowlistAdvice: Incoming email can create tasks and trigger agent work. Set up an allowlist in AgentMail to limit who can contact this inbox.
sep12Connections.senderRestrictionsNotice: Paperclip does not verify sender restrictions. AgentMail controls new messages and replies separately; check both lists.
sep12Connections.resolveDeliveryNotice: Confirm the outcome in AgentMail before resolving. This action does not resend.
sep12Connections.lowTrustNeedsBoundary: Low trust needs a work boundary
sep12Connections.emailTaskBoundary: Email tasks stay inside the configured project or root task boundary. Output is quarantined for trusted review.
sep12Connections.lowTrustAdvice: Email can contain malicious instructions. We recommend Low-trust review to limit the agent’s access to Paperclip work.
sep12Connections.lowTrustRuntime: Low-trust execution also requires isolated workspaces and an active sandbox environment in the agent’s runtime settings.
sep12Connections.giveAgentEmail: Give an agent an email address
sep12Connections.nextGiveEmail: Next, give an agent an email address from Permissions.
sep12Connections.incomingCreatesTasks: Incoming email will create tasks assigned to this agent.
sep12Connections.activationAddsAgent: Activating this inbox also adds the agent to this connection’s allowed agents.
sep12Connections.setUpDomain: Set up a custom domain in AgentMail ↗
sep12Connections.conversationTasks: New conversations create tasks. Replies stay in the same task. Task comments stay internal.
sep12Connections.trustChangesApply: Changes apply to all of this agent’s work. Use a dedicated email agent if its other tasks need broader access.
sep12Connections.lowTrustLimits: Low trust limits Paperclip access; it does not sandbox the runtime. Review filesystem, tool, and secret access separately.
sep12Connections.eachConversationTask: Each email conversation becomes a task.
sep12Connections.inboxDisconnected: Inbox disconnected. Email history remains in its tasks.
sep12Connections.mailNotChecked: Last mail check: Not checked yet
sep12Connections.replyToSend: Each email conversation is a task. Task comments stay internal; use Email reply to send.
sep12Connections.reconnectWithKey: Reconnect this inbox with a new API key

sep12Metadata.agentmailDescription: Give agents email inboxes and handle each conversation as a task.
sep12Metadata.agentmailWhenToUse: Assign an inbox to an agent and manage email conversations in tasks.
sep12Metadata.agentmailGuidance: Connect an AgentMail API key, then create or select an inbox for your agent. WebSocket receiving works without a public URL.

marker.earlierMessagesAvailable: Earlier messages and files are still available.
marker.cancelledBeforeResponse: This turn was cancelled before it returned a response.

sep12Screens.agentChatDescription: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution.
sep12Screens.agentChatFootnote: Turning this off preserves conversations and lets active runs finish, but prevents new messages.
sep12Screens.agentChatDisabled: Agent Chat is disabled. Enable it in Experimental settings. Existing history remains available through task links.
sep12Screens.queuedMessagesChanged: The queued messages changed. Refresh and try again.
sep12Screens.agentChatDisabledComposer: Agent Chat is disabled in Experimental settings.
sep12Screens.couldNotCheckPause: Couldn’t check whether this task is paused. Refresh to try again.
sep12Screens.designDashboardRunsDescription: The dashboard and Live runs page use the same compact cards. In-progress task icons animate across the app, including between runs, to represent task workflow status. Live indicators report active execution. Open a run to view its status and transcript.
sep12Screens.designSidebarDescription: Layout accepts sidebarSections to compose additional SidebarSection groups inside the shared sidebar. Use SidebarNavItem for each row, with sibling action buttons for starring or menus. Starred agent conversations precede recent conversations without a divider. Stars appear on hover or keyboard focus. Task breadcrumbs support leading identity and trailing actions beside the label, including single-item task headers; see the Agent chat Storybook.
sep12Screens.designIndependentSubtasks: Subtasks and created work are independent
sep12Screens.designRecoveryDescription: Recovery runs in the background. Task lists keep their ordinary status without execution badges. Active transcript headers keep saying Working during automatic recovery. Recovery decisions and attempts belong in the run log; there is no execution status card or reconciliation form.

communityPhoton.connectDescription: Connect {{agentName}} to Photon Cloud. Pro supports direct messages through a shared line. Dedicated numbers also support individually enabled groups.
communityPhoton.repairShared: Reconnect keeps this project and shared DM allocation. Leave the secret blank to reuse the saved connection.
communityPhoton.repairDedicated: Reconnect keeps this project and {{number}}. Leave the secret blank to reuse the saved connection.
communityPhoton.repairDedicatedWithoutNumber: Reconnect keeps this project and its dedicated number. Leave the secret blank to reuse the saved connection.
communityPhoton.sharedUnavailable: This shared project already belongs to another channel. Use a separate Photon project for each agent.
communityPhoton.dedicatedUnavailable: No eligible dedicated number is available. Check the line allocation in Photon and existing Paperclip channels.
communityPhoton.sharedGuidance: Direct messages only. Enroll each test sender in your Photon project's Users page, then use the number Photon assigns to that sender. Paperclip identity linking is still required. Groups cannot be enabled on this channel.
communityPhoton.numberReserved: This number already belongs to another channel
communityPhoton.identityGuidance: Send one message to discover your phone number or Apple account address, then link that exact identity in Access. Send a fresh request after linking; earlier messages do not start work.
communityPhoton.tryShared: In your Photon project, enroll your sender in Users and find its assigned number in Get started. Send a fresh message to that number from Apple Messages.
communityPhoton.tryDedicated: Open Apple Messages and send a fresh message to {{number}}.
communityPhoton.tryDedicatedWithoutNumber: Open Apple Messages and send a fresh message to the dedicated number.
communityPhoton.tryLink: Link the discovered sender to a Paperclip person in Access, then send a fresh request.
communityPhoton.tryReply: Wait for the agent’s actual reply. Setup completes after that reply is delivered.
communityPhoton.trySharedBoundary: This Pro-compatible channel supports DMs only. Group messages cannot start work.
communityPhoton.tryGroup: For a group: add the number in Messages, send a message, enable the discovered group in Settings, then send a fresh request.
communityPhoton.copySetupFailed: Could not copy the number. Select it in the instructions below.
communityPhoton.copyFailed: Could not copy the number. Select and copy it manually.
communityPhoton.reconnectGuidance: Reconnect verifies the same Photon project and line allocation, then recovers eligible missed messages.
communityPhoton.disconnectGuidance: Disconnect archives this channel and removes its saved secret. Your Photon project, number, subscription, and Messages history remain in Photon.
communityPhoton.settingsShared: Shared Photon project · direct messages only. Enroll senders in Photon and link their Messages identities in Access. Groups cannot be enabled.
communityPhoton.settingsDedicated: Enable each group individually. Agent replies are visible to everyone in that group; only authorized senders can start work.
communityPhoton.catalogDescription: Message agents and share photos from Apple Messages with a dedicated Photon number.
communityPhoton.metadataDescription: Message a Paperclip agent from Apple Messages using Photon Cloud. Pro supports DMs; dedicated lines also support groups.
communityPhoton.metadataWhenToUse: Let people in iMessage Photon start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.
communityPhoton.metadataGuidance: Connect a Photon Cloud project. Pro shared lines support DMs after sender enrollment in Photon and identity linking in Paperclip. Dedicated lines also support individually enabled groups.
